preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 200,000 characters.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 200,000.
Each query is described by two integers l_i and r_i, where 1 ≤ l_i ≤ r_i ≤ |s|.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == sum(z_i for z_i in z_function if i in range(l_i, r_i + 1))
postconditions.description: For every query, the output should be the Ж-function of the corresponding substring s_{l_i} s_{l_i +1} … s_{r_i}.
